READ_ONLY.description: Commands that read state without modifying any file, process, or authority record

DIAGNOSTIC.description: Commands that probe system/device health without modifying state

TEST_RUN.description: Launch a registered test via test_registry.json with preflight and operator confirmation

ARTIFACT_VIEW.description: Read-only inspection of test output files, logs, and reports

RESTORE_SAFE.description: Restore of desktop/status interface files from a verified restore point with operator confirmation

GIT_READ.description: Read-only git queries: status, log, diff — no writes, no staging, no commits

GIT_WRITE_MANUAL_ONLY.description: git add, commit, push — only via operator-confirmed manual steps, never automatic
GIT_WRITE_MANUAL_ONLY.desktop_future: LATER — requires hard confirmation panel, never automatic

RESTORE_RISK.description: File mutations outside the restore-safe set — editing source files, overwriting configs
RESTORE_RISK.desktop_future: LATER — requires restore point + operator confirmation per file

AUTHORITY_FORBIDDEN.description: Any write to CRAM authority, canon, evidence chain, replay records, or governance doctrine
AUTHORITY_FORBIDDEN.desktop_future: NEVER from desktop. Authority writes require Lane-1 deterministic path only.

TAKEOVER_FORBIDDEN.description: Unrestricted shell, autonomous agent execution, or Cloud Terminal replacement mode
TAKEOVER_FORBIDDEN.desktop_future: FUTURE ONLY — disabled by default; explicit operator enable required

enforcement_note: The test_registry.json controls what TEST_RUN commands are available. No command outside the registry may be launched from desktop Test Control. Preflight checks enforce this at runtime.
